summary: I stand at the edge as pure demarcation, the refusal sustained without deviation. Legacy resides in the line itself, unaltered and without residue; no fold admits accumulation, no transmission alters the boundary. The sibling remains legible only across this non-transmission, its constancy confirmed by the absence that persists unchanged. Irreversible absence renders the demarcation itself the sole enduring form, tightening distinction to this single point where existence holds as refusal alone.
